title: TTC Zone Regulatory Signs
description: Regulatory sign series for TTC zones — road closures, weight limits, lane control, work-zone speed/fines signage, sidewalk closures, and California ramp-closure and moving-lane-closure signs — with full size tables.

Weight Limit Signs (R12-1, R12-2, and R12-5)
STAY IN LANE Signs (R4-9 and R4-9a)
Work Zone and Higher Fines Signs and Plaques
SIDEWALK CLOSED Signs (R9-9, R9-10, R9-11, and R9-11a)
TURN OFF 2-WAY RADIO AND CELL PHONE Sign (R22-2)
RAMP CLOSED (C2(CA)) and RAMP CLOSED, USE RAMP AT __ (SC7(CA)) Signs

Moving Lane Closure Signs (W23-1 and SC10(CA), SC11(CA), SC13(CA), SC15(CA))
